stories.title: Democrats Achieve Major Victory in 2026 Midterm Elections, Trump Acknowledges Impact of Iran War
stories.summary: In a significant shift, Democrats have gained full control of the U.S. Congress following the 2026 midterm elections, marking a decisive rebuke of President Donald Trump and the Republican Party. The election results reflect a wave of Democratic victories across various states, including notable upsets in traditionally Republican strongholds. Trump acknowledged that the ongoing Iran war may have contributed to the electoral losses but refrained from accepting personal responsibility for the outcome.

They attribute the Democratic victories in both chambers of Congress to American voters' concerns over rising prices and the ongoing conflict. The Iranian officials celebrated this outcome as a significant setback for Trump and his administration.

The elections are seen as a crucial indicator of the national sentiment ahead of future national polls, with the ANC expected to face challenges in retaining support due to ongoing frustrations among voters.

stories.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms, a Democrat and former mayor of Atlanta, has won the gubernatorial race in Georgia, making history as the first Black woman elected governor in any U.S. state. Her victory was projected by multiple media outlets on election night.

stories.title: Casualties Rise After Russian Bombing in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine
stories.summary: A Russian bombing of a humanitarian aid site in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region on November 2 has resulted in at least 33 confirmed deaths, with over 50 individuals reported missing. The attack has been described as one of the deadliest in the ongoing conflict, with many survivors suffering severe injuries. Bodycam footage from the scene has emerged, capturing the moments leading up to the strike.

stories.title: Troy Jackson Secures Senate Seat in Maine, Defeating Susan Collins
stories.summary: Democrat Troy Jackson has won the U.S. Senate race in Maine, defeating incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins. Jackson, a former state Senate president and logger, became the Democratic nominee after Graham Platner withdrew from the race in July. His victory is seen as a significant gain for the Democratic Party in the midterm elections.
